notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
[u]This Update v1.1 includes[/u]

I've added a new map with some sweet gattling guns. I feel the length of the game still leaves a bit to be desired so, over the next few weeks going to add some more levels and content for streamers.

Lighting throughout the game has been improved as well as some of the zombie mechanics.

-improved lighing
-more content
-better zombies
-more sfx
